The '''I-2 Incapacitator''' was a common type of [[reversed repulsorfield]], which is a kind of restraining device. It was manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. It was rectangular and measured approximately one by 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meter]], and 10 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] thick.<ref name="Fly" />
